checks_not_implemented.reason: DFM v1 does not yet independently measure pad-to-track distances; KiCad DRC clearance is not a substitute.
KiCad custom rules do not provide an independently verified hole-to-hole constraint in this KiCad 10 environment.
The KiCad custom-rule edge-clearance constraint was not accepted as semantically equivalent; independent edge geometry is not implemented.
Connector mating-face alignment requires a footprint semantic marker not emitted by the independent board parser.
KiCad custom rules cannot be used as a verified via outer-diameter measurement; the independent DFM measurement remains authoritative.
Drill parsing records tool diameters but does not independently classify plated slot width.
Drill parsing records tool diameters but does not independently classify non-plated slot width.
Slot length-to-width ratio is not independently measured.
Soldermask bridge geometry is not independently measured.
Pad-to-track and PTH-to-track geometry is not independently measured.
Graph component data does not include package dimensions.
Graph component data does not include IC pin pitch.
Graph component data does not include BGA pitch.

ground_plane.cost_note: Adopted 1/20 guided-wavelength perimeter stitch pitch; through-via and drill counts are recorded against the fab profile as cost drivers. Interior stitch candidates use the same pitch only when an isolated GND island requires a connection.

stitch_via_candidates.board_edge_inset_basis: Candidates are generated inside the board edge inset; no post-generation edge rejection is performed.
stitch_via_candidates.footprint_clearance_method: Rotated body/courtyard corners with an axis-aligned bounding box, expanded by via radius plus clearance.

stitch_via_pitch_measurement.basis: Filled F.Cu and B.Cu Gerber flash centers independently matched to each requested stitch via location.

via_profile_cost_evidence.count_based_cost_driver_note: The fab profile has geometry/process thresholds but no numeric per-via quantity surcharge; added via and drill counts are recorded as process burden.

+3V3.copper_thickness_source: JLCPCB 1 oz copper capability declaration: 35 µm nominal outer-layer copper
+3V3.formula_source: IPC-2221 current-capacity equation: A = (I / (k * ΔT^b))^(1/c), width = A / thickness; IPC-2221, external/internal conductor current-capacity method.
+3V3.path_resistance_basis: Shortest resistance path between measured pads over saved-board segment endpoints and routed via endpoints; GND plane return is not represented.
+3V3.upper_bound_basis: Total routed conductor length is treated as one series path; parallel branches are ignored. For GND, the filled-plane return path is omitted, so this is a pessimistic routed-conductor upper bound.
+3V3.via_resistance_model: Routed via endpoint connections are modeled as ideal zero-ohm connections because barrel plating resistance is not measured.
+3V3.width_basis_source: Regulated 3.3 V power net; IPC-2221 external-layer current capacity governs the routed conductor.
